text: {"label":"Functional Analysis of Inappropriate Mealtime Behavior","definition":"Research on assessing and treating inappropriate or challenging mealtime behavior. It centres on functional and descriptive analyses that identify maintaining contingencies and guide function-based feeding treatment, with some work on broader eating problems.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on the function of disruptive mealtime behavior, not on extinction-based treatment of food refusal, food presentation and reinforcement schedules, or treatment of food selectivity in autism."}
